title: 摩根大通鲍勃·鲍勃·米歇尔：美联储明年或“维护性加息”
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Do you feel like this Fed is hawkish? Kevin Worsh is hawkish.
segments.zh: 你觉得美联储偏鹰吗？凯文·沃什是鹰派。

segments.en: But there's not going to be any sort of hike this year.
Does he need to deliver? Lisa made this point earlier. If you want to set deterrence, don't need to act on it.
segments.zh: 他需要行动吗？丽莎之前说过，要威慑不必真动手。

segments.en: So people believe that it's real. Yeah, I think that's Lagarde's mantra is what's the point of having a reaction function
segments.zh: 所以人们相信这是真的。拉加德的口头禅是：反应函数有什么用？

segments.en: if you don't react. Well, we don't know what his reaction function is.
segments.zh: 如果不反应的话。但我们不知道他的反应函数是什么。

segments.en: Maybe he'll detail some of that in Cintra.
segments.zh: 也许他会在辛特拉详细说明。

segments.en: When you roll out five task forces that report back by year end, you're pretty much saying you're
segments.zh: 当你推出五个工作组并在年底前汇报时，你基本上是在说：

segments.en: going to glide into year end and only move things if something dramatic happens.
segments.zh: 你会平稳过渡到年底，除非发生重大事件才会行动。

segments.en: I don't know that anything dramatic will happen between now and year end.
segments.zh: 我不认为从现在到年底会发生什么重大事件。

segments.en: We were talking with Matt Hornbach earlier. We were just playing that clip from Morgan Stanley who said that he thinks the Fed will remain unhold, similar call to you.
segments.zh: 我们之前和马特·霍恩巴赫聊过，刚放了摩根士丹利的片段，他们认为美联储会按兵不动，和你的观点类似。

segments.en: But then the Fed's going to cut in 2027.
Do you think that's the path of travel? Because based on what you're saying with the re-acceleration of the US economy, let's clear.
segments.zh: 您认为这是政策路径吗？因为根据您说的美国经济重新加速，我们得明确一下。

segments.en: That's not what we're expecting. We're expecting that these underlying trends in growth, that the amount of money sloshing around the system,
segments.zh: 这不是我们的预期。我们预计增长的基本趋势、系统中流动的资金量，

segments.en: all the capex that's going on in the US and globally will start to accelerate growth and inflation pressures.
segments.zh: 以及美国和全球的资本支出将加速增长和通胀压力。

segments.en: And the Fed will have to come back in next year and hike rates once or twice.
segments.zh: 美联储明年将不得不加息一到两次。

segments.en: This is not a dramatic hiking cycle, like what we saw going into 2022 into 2023.
segments.zh: 这不是像2022到2023年那样剧烈的加息周期。
